borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
decision_conditions: <div><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;">The proposed studio flat is considered to be incongruous with the existing architectural style of the host block of flats thus, its construction would disrupt the building's clean, rectangular form and result in an awkward, overdeveloped and claustrophobic appearance on the modest external storage space.</span><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;">&nbsp;</span></span>As such, the proposed development is contrary to:<br></div><div><br></div><div><p>-National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, December 2024)&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; -Policy D4 of the London Plan (March 2021)&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; -Policies DMD1 and&nbsp;&nbsp;SP2&nbsp;&nbsp;of The Barking and Dagenham Local Plan (September 2024)&nbsp;&nbsp;</p></div>

<p>The proposed development, by reason of its excessive depth and siting, would constitute unacceptable levels of&nbsp;overbearing,&nbsp;overshadowing and loss of daylight impacts to the adjoining flat.&nbsp;The proposed development therefore constitutes unneighbourly development and is contrary to:</p><p>- National Planning Policy Framework National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, December 2024)</p><p>- Policy D4 of the London Plan (March 2021);</p><p>- Policies DMD1 and&nbsp;SP2&nbsp;of The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037: (September 2024)</p><p>- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012);</p>

<p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 7.5pt;"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">The proposed development fails to provide appropriate levels of outlook, daylight and ventilation due to being single aspect. This is at the detriment of the quality of living for the occupiers of the host dwellinghouse. As such, the proposal is not considered to be able to provide a satisfactory lifestyle for future residents. The proposal is therefore contrary to the following:</span><u1:p></u1:p><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif;"><o:p></o:p></span></p><p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 7.5pt 36pt;"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">-&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">The&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (</span>MHCLG, December 2024<span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">);</span></p><p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 7.5pt 36pt;"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">- Policies D4 and D6 of the London Plan (March 2021)</span></p>

<p>The applicant&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">has failed to provide sufficient evidence that the proposed development would exacerbate the existing parking stress in the area.</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">&nbsp;</span>As such, it fails to comply with the following policies::</p><ul><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 11pt;">National Planning Policy Framework (<span style="font-size: 14px; text-align: start;">MHCLG,&nbsp;</span>December 2024)</span></li><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 11pt;">Policies T1, T2, T4, T6 and T6.1 of the London Plan (March 2021)</span></li><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 11pt;">Policy DMT2 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)</span></li></ul>
